It's more than just SPF

UV light consists of both UVA and UVB rays, with both contributing to skin damage caused by sun exposure. 

Many chemical UV absorbers provide inadequate UVA protection. SPF ratings only measure protection from UVB, leaving out potential damage from UVA. 

Our zinc has been specifically designed to enhance the UVA protection performance and offers market-leading protection across the UV spectrum.

Safe from chemicals

Zinc oxide has a long history in skincare products such as calamine lotion and nappy rash creams, for use on even the most sensitive of skin.

Many common chemical sunscreens have been found to cause damage to coral and ocean life plus free radical damage, endocrine, hormone and DNA disruption in humans.

Ethical Zinc is safe from harmful chemicals and contains 22% zinc oxide as the active ingredient.

Works in the real world

Common chemical based sunscreens might pass tests in the lab, but have been shown to degrade or break down in as little as 30 minutes when exposed to real sunlight, limiting their ability to protect you.

Ethical Zinc's physical zinc oxide barrier keeps working under real world conditions, maintaining very high broad spectrum UVA and UVB protection.

description: Coral reef death is happening at a rapid pace. While sunscreen is not the main cause, we would like to do our part and reduce even the smallest amount of ecosystem damage. According to the National Park Service, “4,000 to 6,000 TONS of sunscreen enters reef areas annually. This does not spread out rapidly or evenly over the entire ocean, but concentrates on popular tourist sites. It is estimated that 90% of snorkeling/diving tourists are concentrated on 10% of the world’s reefs.” “Seawater surrounding coral exposed to sunscreen contained up to 15 times more viruses than unexposed samples… the effect is not dose dependent—so coral's exposure to a very small dose of sunscreen is just as dangerous as a high exposure.” Hawaii is working on two bills about learning how common sunscreen ingredients harm coral reefs, and banning use or application of sunscreen with damaging ingredients like oxybenzone and octinoxate, neither of which Coral Isles has. Please help us educate people about the how harmful wearing the wrong sunscreen into the water can be – and let them know that even if they just wear it on the beach and don’t go into the ocean, it can still make its way to the water through showering, restroom use, or walking on the sand. Let’s work together to save the reefs from future damage!

description:
Beta-SOLAR is a comprehensive formula with components of the highest quality. The special combination of active substances – Pro Tan Blend – acting in synergy to support the tanning process helps your skin reach the desired dark tone much faster and at the same time it shortens the time of exposure to the fractions of solar radiation that are dangerous to your body. Carotenoids contained in Pro Tan Blend also act as a unique filter against harmful UV rays and limit the effects of infrared radiation. The most effective antioxidants contained in Antiox-protect skin Blend affect the whole area of skin, securing it against the free radicals formed during sunbathing. The addition ofhyaluronic acid deeply moisturises your skin, making it less prone to losing its firmness and elasticity. 

Why does skin turn brown? 

The change of skin colour during sunbathing is simply a natural defence reaction. This is how the body defends itself against sunburn and excessive exposure to harmful UV radiation. Skin is a very complex organ. Out of all the cells used to form its structures, melanocytes ought to be subjected to special scrutiny. They produce melanin – the pigment responsible for the beautiful golden-brown skin colour we refer to as tan. 

Tan – a parasol. 

Melanocytes produce melanin in response to UV radiation (mainly UVB) – a component of sunrays. Melanin is a pigment capable of absorbing UV waves. It gives the skin natural protection against harmful effects of ultraviolet and sunburns.

About Suntegrity

I founded Suntegrity to honor the memory of my mom and all of those who lost their lives to skin cancer.

Using my mom's experience as a positive catalyst for change, I created a holistic, mineral sun care line to help people avoid skin cancer.

After losing my mom to melanoma skin cancer, I became a big advocate of wearing sunscreen. However, most of the sunscreens on the market use chemical UV blockers and contain a lot of toxic ingredients. It didn't make sense to me to use these types of sunscreens to prevent skin cancer only to get another kind of cancer.

I hope you enjoy our products and smile in the memory of someone you love every time you use them.

Mineral Sunscreen Lotion FAQs

WHAT IS THE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN CHEMICAL AND MINERAL SUNSCREENS? Chemical sunscreens are generally thinner and have chemical actives that absorb into the body and bloodstream where they fight and break up the UV rays. Mineral sunscreens are formulated to be slightly thicker, resting on the top layers of the skin to completely block and reflect the UV rays. Unlike chemical sunscreens, Sunblocz does not absorb into the skin and bloodstream and does not contain harmful chemicals that are released inside the body.

WHY ZINC OXIDE VERSUS TITANIUM DIOXIDE? Zinc Oxide is the most effective UV blocker across the entire UVA and UVB spectrum and is a better sunscreen active ingredient than titanium dioxide. It is also safer as it limits the creation of free radicals that do damage to your cells and increase the risk of skin cancer.

description: Many of the skin problems mentioned in the target groups are due to the harmful effects of sun radiation. UV light, frequently over-dosed, may damage the cell nucleus of the DNS, attack the protective cell membrane of the skin cells and cause inflammatory processes such as redness, swellings or painful formation of blisters being the different pre-stages of a sun burn. UVA and UVB rays both lead to biological modifications in the skin. For this reason, it is absolutely necessary to include a protection against both UV-ray types in a medically-based sun-protection product. Skin has its natural own defense mechanisms in order to protect itself against damages caused by UV radiation: The horny layer acts as a „natural“ UV filter and is able to absorb or reflect approx. 10% of the UVB and 50% of the UVA rays. With the increasing exposure to radiation, the horny layer becomes thicker. Melanin – also a natural defense mechanism – is developed in the deeper skin layers and absorbs and/or spreads there in particular the UVB rays. In the event of a longer lasting exposure to sun, there are modifications in the blood circulation including widening of the vessels (erythema), increased melanin formation (tanning of skin) and cell renewal (when the skin starts to flake).

description: Coral reef death is happening at a rapid pace. While sunscreen is not the main cause, we would like to do our part and reduce even the smallest amount of ecosystem damage. According to the National Park Service, “4,000 to 6,000 TONS of sunscreen enters reef areas annually. This does not spread out rapidly or evenly over the entire ocean, but concentrates on popular tourist sites. It is estimated that 90% of snorkeling/diving tourists are concentrated on 10% of the world’s reefs.” “Seawater surrounding coral exposed to sunscreen contained up to 15 times more viruses than unexposed samples… the effect is not dose dependent—so coral's exposure to a very small dose of sunscreen is just as dangerous as a high exposure.” Hawaii is working on two bills about learning how common sunscreen ingredients harm coral reefs, and banning use or application of sunscreen with damaging ingredients like oxybenzone and octinoxate, neither of which Coral Isles has. Please help us educate people about the how harmful wearing the wrong sunscreen into the water can be – and let them know that even if they just wear it on the beach and don’t go into the ocean, it can still make its way to the water through showering, restroom use, or walking on the sand. Let’s work together to save the reefs from future damage!

description: Too often, fishermen avoid using sunscreen because they fear that sunscreens repel fish. With Sunfisher, there is no need to trade-off sun safety for fishing success! We know that to be effective, a sunscreen must be applied frequently throughout the day. But when handling fishing gear, it is inevitable that sunscreen contamination—from hands to baits and lures—will occur. That is why we developed Sunfisher. We wanted to stop worrying that, when protecting our health, we might also be harming the bite. So, we designed Sunfisher sunscreen with fish-friendly fragrances designed to not scare away fish. From the beginning, we were mindful of the fact that fish can detect odors in concentrations as low as several parts per billion. So, using a “fragrance-free” sunscreen was not the answer. Sunscreens that advertise as “fragrance-free” simply means no extra fragrance is added to a sunscreen—the chemical odors of the active and inactive ingredients are still present, and easily detected by fish. What was needed are scents that mask these chemical odors and even attract fish, and so we added fragrances that are pleasingly fresh with the mild scent of anise. These fish-friendly fragrances help to protect the bite, while also providing you the sun protection that you need. We recommend that you always use sunscreen to protect you and your family while fishing. We use Sunfisher sunscreen while fishing for everything from pan fish to sport fish like BASS, STEELHEAD, SALMON, TROUT, CATFISH, KOKANEE, CARP and other popular freshwater and saltwater species.

description: Too often, fishermen avoid using sunscreen because they fear that sunscreens repel fish. With Sunfisher, there is no need to trade-off sun safety for fishing success! We know that to be effective, a sunscreen must be applied frequently throughout the day. But when handling fishing gear, it is inevitable that sunscreen contamination—from hands to baits and lures—will occur. That is why we developed Sunfisher. We wanted to stop worrying that, when protecting our health, we might also be harming the bite. So, we designed Sunfisher sunscreen with fish-friendly fragrances designed to not scare away fish. From the beginning, we were mindful of the fact that fish can detect odors in concentrations as low as several parts per billion. So, using a “fragrance-free” sunscreen was not the answer. Sunscreens that advertise as “fragrance-free” simply means no extra fragrance is added to a sunscreen—the chemical odors of the active and inactive ingredients are still present, and easily detected by fish. What was needed are scents that mask these chemical odors and even attract fish, and so we added fragrances that are pleasingly fresh with the mild scent of anise. These fish-friendly fragrances help to protect the bite, while also providing you the sun protection that you need. We recommend that you always use sunscreen to protect you and your family while fishing. We use Sunfisher sunscreen while fishing for everything from pan fish to sport fish like BASS, STEELHEAD, SALMON, TROUT, CATFISH, KOKANEE, CARP and other popular freshwater and saltwater species.

description:
Scent Name: Lavender Jivi started with a problem. Most of the skin care around us is full of crap: petrochemicals, synthetics, and active ingredients extracted and isolated from their plants. We were constantly turning to the back of supposedly natural products to find ingredients that were clearly produced in a lab, not in nature. Or we’d look online and find companies highlighting the few natural ingredients they use, while hiding or not listing the remaining unnatural ingredients (not a good sign). And the products that were natural were too expensive for us to use daily. So, we started Jivi to create a truly natural and affordable skin care option with ingredients we're happy to show off. All of our products are made by us, in the USA, out of 100% natural ingredients. They are both highly effective and safe enough to eat. Yep, you read that right. Skin is the largest organ of our bodies, and a lot of what we put on it gets absorbed into our bloodstream. So we decided that if we can’t eat it, we shouldn’t feed it to our skin. That means no chemicals, no parabens, and nothing synthetic. We’re rethinking skin care: from how we source our ingredients and formulate our products to how we bottle them (to avoid harsh preservatives) and get them to your doorstep. We are always looking for ways to create options for better health. We recognize that skin care is a luxury, and that there are people around us who are more concerned with what they can put in their bodies than on them. In almost every community across our country, people we interact with on a daily basis, co-workers and classmates, may be forced to make difficult choices: do I eat or pay rent? do I feed my family or get my insulin? As members of those communities, we want to be part of the solution. 향기 이름: 라벤더 지비는 문제로 시작했습니다. 우리 주변의 스킨 케어의 대부분은 석유 화학 물질, 합성 및 활성 성분이 식물에서 추출되고 분리되어 있습니다. 우리는 자연이 아닌 실험실에서 명확하게 생산된 성분을 찾기 위해 끊임없이 천연 제품의 뒷면을 찾아왔습니다. 또는 저희는 온라인에서 볼 때 사용하는 몇 가지 천연 재료를 강조하는 회사를 발견하고 나머지 부자연적 성분을 숨기거나 나열하지 않은 동안 발견할 것입니다. 그리고 천연 제품은 매일 사용하기에 너무 비싸기 때문에 너무 비쌉니다. 그래서 Jivi를 시작해서 저희가 자랑하게 되어 기쁩니다. 저희의 모든 제품은 100% 천연 성분으로 미국에서 제작됩니다. 매우 효과적이고 먹을 수 있을 만큼 안전합니다. 네, 제대로 읽으셨습니다. 피부는 우리 몸에서 가장 큰 기관이며, 우리가 착용하는 많은 것이 우리의 혈류에 흡수됩니다. 그래서 우리는 먹을 수 없다면 피부에 먹이면 안된다고 결정했습니다. 즉, 화학 물질, 파라벤, 합성 물질이 없음을 의미합니다. 당사는 스킨 케어를 재고하고 있습니다: 재료를 공급하고 제품을 제조하는 방법부터 병에 넣는 방법(독한 방부제를 피하기 위함)까지, 그리고 고객의 집 앞에 가져갈 수 있습니다. 당사는 항상 더 나은 건강을 위한 옵션을 만드는 방법을 찾고 있습니다. 우리는 스킨 케어가 고급스러움이라는 것을 알고 있으며, 우리 주변에는 그들이 몸에 넣을 수 있는 것에 더 관심을 가진 사람들이 있다는 것을 알고 있습니다. 우리 나라 전역의 거의 모든 커뮤니티에서 우리가 매일 상호 작용하는 사람들은 동료 및 반 친구들이 어려운 선택을 해야 할 수 있습니다. 먹거나 임대료를 지불합니까? 가족에게 먹이거나 인슐린을 섭취합니까? 이러한 커뮤니티의 일원으로서 저희는 솔루션의 일부가 되기를 바랍니다. 저희는 전국의 푸드 뱅크와 제휴를 맺어 고객이 사는 모든 병에 대해 필요한 사람에게 식사를 기부합니다. 이렇게 하면 훌륭한 피부를 얻고 주변 사람들의 삶을 개선하는 데 도움이 됩니다.

description: Too often, fishermen avoid using sunscreen because they fear that sunscreens repel fish. With Sunfisher, there is no need to trade-off sun safety for fishing success! We know that to be effective, a sunscreen must be applied frequently throughout the day. But when handling fishing gear, it is inevitable that sunscreen contamination—from hands to baits and lures—will occur. That is why we developed Sunfisher. We wanted to stop worrying that, when protecting our health, we might also be harming the bite. So, we designed Sunfisher sunscreen with fish-friendly fragrances designed to not scare away fish. From the beginning, we were mindful of the fact that fish can detect odors in concentrations as low as several parts per billion. So, using a “fragrance-free” sunscreen was not the answer. Sunscreens that advertise as “fragrance-free” simply means no extra fragrance is added to a sunscreen—the chemical odors of the active and inactive ingredients are still present, and easily detected by fish. What was needed are scents that mask these chemical odors and even attract fish, and so we added fragrances that are pleasingly fresh with the mild scent of anise. These fish-friendly fragrances help to protect the bite, while also providing you the sun protection that you need. We recommend that you always use sunscreen to protect you and your family while fishing. We use Sunfisher sunscreen while fishing for everything from pan fish to sport fish like BASS, STEELHEAD, SALMON, TROUT, CATFISH, KOKANEE, CARP and other popular freshwater and saltwater species.

description:
Jivi started with a problem. Most of the skin care around us is full of crap: petrochemicals, synthetics, and active ingredients extracted and isolated from their plants. We were constantly turning to the back of supposedly natural products to find ingredients that were clearly produced in a lab, not in nature. Or we’d look online and find companies highlighting the few natural ingredients they use, while hiding or not listing the remaining unnatural ingredients (not a good sign). And the products that were natural were too expensive for us to use daily. So, we started Jivi to create a truly natural and affordable skin care option with ingredients we're happy to show off.

All of our products are made by us, in the USA, out of 100% natural ingredients. They are both highly effective and safe enough to eat. Yep, you read that right. Skin is the largest organ of our bodies, and a lot of what we put on it gets absorbed into our bloodstream. So we decided that if we can’t eat it, we shouldn’t feed it to our skin. That means no chemicals, no parabens, and nothing synthetic. We’re rethinking skin care: from how we source our ingredients and formulate our products to how we bottle them (to avoid harsh preservatives) and get them to your doorstep.

We are always looking for ways to create options for better health. We recognize that skin care is a luxury, and that there are people around us who are more concerned with what they can put in their bodies than on them. In almost every community across our country, people we interact with on a daily basis, co-workers and classmates, may be forced to make difficult choices: do I eat or pay rent? do I feed my family or get my insulin? As members of those communities, we want to be part of the solution. We partner with food banks across the country so that for every bottle you buy, we donate a meal, where you live, to a person in need. Jivi는 문제로 시작되었습니다. 우리 주변의 스킨 케어의 대부분은 석유 화학 물질, 합성 및 활성 성분이 식물에서 추출되고 분리되어 있습니다. 우리는 자연이 아닌 실험실에서 명확하게 생산된 성분을 찾기 위해 끊임없이 천연 제품의 뒷면을 찾아왔습니다. 또는 저희는 온라인에서 볼 때 사용하는 몇 가지 천연 재료를 강조하는 회사를 발견하고 나머지 부자연적 성분을 숨기거나 나열하지 않은 동안 발견할 것입니다. 그리고 천연 제품은 매일 사용하기에 너무 비싸기 때문에 너무 비쌉니다. 그래서 Jivi를 시작해서 저희가 자랑하게 되어 기쁩니다.

당사는 항상 더 나은 건강을 위한 옵션을 만드는 방법을 찾고 있습니다. 우리는 스킨 케어가 고급스러움이라는 것을 알고 있으며, 우리 주변에는 그들이 몸에 넣을 수 있는 것에 더 관심을 가진 사람들이 있다는 것을 알고 있습니다. 우리 나라 전역의 거의 모든 커뮤니티에서 우리가 매일 상호 작용하는 사람들은 동료 및 반 친구들이 어려운 선택을 해야 할 수 있습니다. 먹거나 임대료를 지불합니까? 가족에게 먹이거나 인슐린을 섭취합니까? 이러한 커뮤니티의 일원으로서 저희는 솔루션의 일부가 되기를 바랍니다. 저희는 전국의 푸드 뱅크와 제휴를 맺어 고객이 사는 모든 병에 대해 필요한 사람에게 식사를 기부합니다. 이렇게 하면 훌륭한 피부를 얻고 주변 사람들의 삶을 개선하는 데 도움이 됩니다.

Bei Thinksport erweitern wir unsere Mission kontinuierlich, sichere Produkte zu bieten, indem wir Produktkategorien der Verbraucher mit bekannten menschlichen Gesundheitsproblemen identifizieren. Na Thinksport, estamos continuamente expandindo nossa missão de fornecer produtos seguros identificando as categorias de produtos de consumo com problemas de saúde humana conhecidos. 在 Thinksport ,我们不断扩大我们的使命,即通过识别有已知人类健康问题的消费者产品类别,提供安全产品。 具体而言,我们针对含有高水平荷尔蒙干扰剂和致癌物质的产品。 目前市场上的大多数防晒霜都含有可疑成分和已知的致癌物质。 只需看一下成分,您就能很快意识到它们不存在。 许多现有防晒霜已经推向市场,对其安全性无关。 防晒霜中的成分不仅与皮肤相互作用,而且数据显示,使用乳液后,血液中可以检测到相同化学物质。 大多数人佩戴防晒霜以减少患癌的机会,那么为什么要选择可能增加这种风险的东西呢? 遗憾的是,这个问题使许多人远离使用防晒霜。 Thinksport 防晒霜具有最高的 SPF、防水(80 分钟)、长波紫外线(2012 年指南的建议)。 该配方不使用纳米(超小)氧化锌或气溶胶喷雾。 虽然使用气溶胶很简单,但我们担心使用的成分可能会吸入化学物质和科学,这证明大多数用户应用的量少于达到 SPF 水平。 自2010年以来,我们的防晒霜一直被EWG 的皮肤深度数据库评为高水平,评分为"1"。 易于涂抹,不会油腻。 因此,我们有许多专业运动员到周末的勇士使用这款产品,因为他们不会因穿着防晒霜而感到"沉重"。 未经动物测试。 我们的防晒系列也赢得了更多的奖项。

Thinksport는 알려진 인체 건강 문제로 소비자 제품 카테고리를 식별하여 안전한 제품을 제공하려는 사명을 지속적으로 확장하고 있습니다. 특히, 저희는 높은 수준의 호르몬 장애물과 발암 물질을 함유하는 제품을 목표로 합니다. 현재 시장에 나와있는 대부분의 자외선 차단제는 의심스러운 성분과 발암 물질로 가득합니다. 재료를 간단히 보면 그 어떤 성분도 인식하지 못한다는 것을 알게 될 것입니다. 기존의 많은 자외선 차단제는 안전에 대한 걱정이 거의 없이 시장에 출시되었습니다. 자외선 차단제의 성분은 피부와 상호 작용할 뿐만 아니라 로션을 바른 후에 데이터가 표시됩니다. 동일한 화학 물질 중 일부가 혈류에서 검출될 수 있습니다. 대부분의 사람들은 암을 일으킬 가능성을 줄이기 위해 자외선 차단제를 착용합니다. 왜 이러한 위험을 증가시킬 수 있는 제품을 사용할까요? 이 질문은 불행히도 많은 사람들이 자외선 차단제를 전혀 사용하지 못하게 했습니다. Thinksport 자외선 차단제는 FDA의 2012 가이드라인에서 제안한 대로 최고 SPF, 방수 (80분), UVA/UVB 를 자랑합니다. 이 포뮬러는 나노 (초소형) 산화아연 또는 에어로졸 스프레이를 사용하지 않습니다. 에어로졸 적용은 쉽지만 사용되는 성분에 대해 우려하고 있습니다. 대부분의 사용자가 SPF 레벨을 달성하기 위해 양보다 적게 적용한 화학 물질과 과학을 흡입할 수 있는 잠재력을 보여줍니다. 저희 자외선 차단제는 EWG의 Skin Deep 데이터베이스로 2010년부터 "1" 등급을 받았습니다. 쉽게 바를 수 있으며 기름지지 않습니다. 이러한 이유로 저희는 자외선 차단제를 착용했을 때 "무거움"이라고 느끼지 않기 때문에 주말에 많은 프로 운동 선수들이 제품을 사용하고 있습니다. 동물 실험을 하지 않았습니다. 당사의 자외선 차단 라인은 다른 자외선 차단 라인보다 더 많은 상을 받았습니다.

title: VL Pure Broad Spectrum SPF 55Lightweight Water Resistant Sunscreen Lotion
bullet_point: [sunscreen moisturizer]
description: This lightweight formula employs both zinc oxide and octinoxate to ensure that cells stay safe from the damaging UV rays of the sun. These trusted ingredients use a 2-step system that absorbs the UVB rays that cause sunburn, while diffusing the UVA rays that cause premature aging and cellular damage. These ingredients join forces with silky hydrators such as aloe vera and sunflower oil to help the skin retain moisture. How It Works: UV Rays are some of the most damaging environmental aggressors, ravaging through multiple layers of the skin, creating both short and long term damage. UVB rays, which have shorter wavelengths, are the culprits behind surface burns. They also stimulate the melanin producing cells known as melanocytes. As the melanocytes produce melanin to help the skin absorb the ultraviolet light, they often end up overproducing, resulting in dark spots, hyperpigmentation, and uneven skintone. UVA rays, however, behave differently. With a much longer wavelength, UVA rays are responsible for photoaging, and are able to wreak havoc within the deeper layers of the skin. By impairing the collagen fibers responsible for rebuilding damaged skin, UVA rays essentially throw the aging process into overdrive, resulting in wrinkles, fine lines, and a massive loss of elasticity. Zinc oxide, a powdered mineral, helps to defend from UV rays, by diffusing and scattering them. Octinoxate works in tandem with zinc oxide, effortlessly absorbing the UVB rays that cause immediate and visible damage. Both of these actives are blended with soothing aloe vera and ultra-hydrating sunflower oil. Botanically derived, these ingredients ensure that skin is able to retain moisture.

UVA 광선은 햇볕에 화상을 일으키지 않지만 UVB 광선처럼 피부암을 일으킬 수 있습니다. 모든 선스크린에는 태양의 자외선을 차단하는 성분이 포함되어 있습니다. 보호량은 자외선 차단 지수 (SPF)로 표시됩니다. 피부과 전문의는 효과적인 자외선 차단 립밤을 위해 30 이상의 SPF 제품을 권장합니다. 대부분의 립 SPF는 옥시벤존 또는 옥티살레이트를 함유하고 있습니다. 이러한 화학 물질은 알레르기 반응을 일으킬 수 있으며 (Fisher's Contact Dermatitis 제4판 23장), 입술을 훨씬 악화시킬 수 있습니다. Dr. Dan's SunBlock SPF30은 화학 물질이 없습니다. 대신 이산화티타늄과 이산화아연이라고 불리는 두 개의 천연 불활성 미네랄을 사용합니다. 이 미네랄은 작은 거울처럼 작용하며 자외선이 입술에서 다시 반사됩니다. 이 작은 보호 필름은 약간 흰색이기 때문에 Dr. Dan은 "입술이 약간 하얗다면 괜찮을 것입니다! 또한, 천연 옐로우 왁스와 화학 물질이 없는 베이스와 항산화 비타민 E가 결합되어 완벽한 보습 조합을 만듭니다.

description: Too often, fishermen avoid using sunscreen because they fear that sunscreens repel fish. With Sunfisher, there is no need to trade-off sun safety for fishing success! We know that to be effective, a sunscreen must be applied frequently throughout the day. But when handling fishing gear, it is inevitable that sunscreen contamination—from hands to baits and lures—will occur. That is why we developed Sunfisher. We wanted to stop worrying that, when protecting our health, we might also be harming the bite. So, we designed Sunfisher sunscreen with fish-friendly fragrances designed to not scare away fish. From the beginning, we were mindful of the fact that fish can detect odors in concentrations as low as several parts per billion. So, using a “fragrance-free” sunscreen was not the answer. Sunscreens that advertise as “fragrance-free” simply means no extra fragrance is added to a sunscreen—the chemical odors of the active and inactive ingredients are still present, and easily detected by fish. What was needed are scents that mask these chemical odors and even attract fish, and so we added fragrances that are pleasingly fresh with the mild scent of anise. These fish-friendly fragrances help to protect the bite, while also providing you the sun protection that you need. We recommend that you always use sunscreen to protect you and your family while fishing. We use Sunfisher sunscreen while fishing for everything from pan fish to sport fish like BASS, STEELHEAD, SALMON, TROUT, CATFISH, KOKANEE, CARP and other popular freshwater and saltwater species.
